release_notes: Island is now called DeskHalo. Updating keeps all your settings, notes and history

Cursors: 14 original pointer packs, from Fluent to Arcane, Ronin, Inferno, Frost, Neon and 8-Bit Hero, with matching hand, text, resize and busy pointers at any size. One click puts your old pointers back
Screen Time: see every minute of your day by app and by hour, with idle time left out and everything kept on your PC

Ambient mode: 12 visualizer styles including Constellation, Punch, Messages, Studio, Depth, Lens, Code, Branches, Web and Lock screen, sharper 3D album art and a smoother look on low-resolution covers
Edge light: new speeds (slow to superfast and DJ) and shapes (notch and curved edges), with your own colours
Lyrics stay in sync after you pause, and no longer jump when you change style
Ask and Translate no longer get stuck retrying: Flash-Lite is the default, and DeskHalo switches models straight away when a free limit is hit
New icons in Settings, smoother scrolling in Screen Time, and lower CPU and memory use while idle
